Returns reactive access to the effective app hotkeys from `HotkeysProvider`,
typed by `Register`.

## Returns

[`SvelteAppHotkeys`](../interfaces/SvelteAppHotkeys.md)

## Example

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  const appHotkeys = getAppHotkeys()
  createHotkey(() => appHotkeys.current['doc.save'], () => save())
</script>
```
